docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Tibetan history of Buddhism in India by Sumpa Khenpo (1747), edited with a long English introduction by Sarat Chandra Das, with the lists of the Indian teachers (Calcutta, 1908). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by Google from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Pag sam jon zang · Sumpa Khan-po Yeçe Pal Jor, 1702-1775, Das, Sarat Chandra, 1849-1917, ed · 1908, 630 scanned pages. Published 1908; Sumpa Khenpo lived 1702–1775 and Sarat Chandra Das died 1917; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
